statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and dizziness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, CPT 93229, was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to correlate arrhythmic events with symptomatic giddiness
The claim was denied under CO-197
The denial was for lack of precertification or authorization prior to the date of service
